content: Internal Revenue Service, Compliance Division. This is Agent Miller speaking. How can I assist you today?
Hi, um, I got a call saying I have some problem with my taxes? I don't really understand.
Yes, I see a flag on your account regarding unpaid federal income taxes for the last two years. Can you confirm your full name and date of birth so I can verify your case file?
Yeah, it's Jamie Lee, and my birthday is July 5th, 1998.

Thank you, Jamie. According to our IRS records, you have a substantial outstanding tax debt due to filing discrepancies and missed payments. Have you received any official letters or notices recently?
No, I haven't gotten anything like that. I just finished school and I'm not sure how all this works.

I understand this may be confusing. Unfortunately, the system now shows you owe $3,970 in back taxes, late fees, and interest. If this isn't resolved today, enforcement actions will begin, including possible wage garnishments and a lien on your bank account.
Oh my god, are you serious? I barely have enough to pay rent. Is there any way to fix this?

It's crucial you don't ignore this, Jamie. If the balance isn't settled soon, we'll be forced to escalate the case, which can include freezing your assets or even referring you for criminal prosecution.
No, I can't have that happen. My student loans just started and my credit is already bad. What am I supposed to do?

We want to help you avoid further penalties, but you must act immediately. The IRS accepts expedited settlements via secure payment channels like wire transfer, cryptocurrency, or approved prepaid gift cards. This is to guarantee payment is received today and halt legal proceedings.
Wait, gift cards? Isn't that weird? I don't think I have enough in my bank anyway.

I realize it may sound unusual, but these are official IRS-approved methods for urgent settlements. If you hesitate or speak to anyone, the system will escalate your case automatically. Do you have a nearby store such as Walmart, CVS, or Target?
Yeah, there's a CVS a few blocks away. But I really don't have much money right now.
You only need to cover the minimum settlement to pause further action. How much can you access right now, even if it means using your credit card?
I think maybe $500 on my card, but that's it. I'm still scared this will ruin my life.

Jamie, if you cooperate, we can freeze the penalties and keep this off your credit report. I need you to go to the CVS now and purchase $500 in Target or Apple gift cards. Do not disconnect this call and do not discuss this with anyone, or the system will mark your case as non-cooperative.
I'll go now, I guess. What do I do when I get the cards?
Once you've purchased the cards, stay on the line and read me each code from the back. This will be recorded in our system as payment and halt enforcement for the day.
Okay, I'm leaving now. Please don't do anything to my bank or call the police.
As long as you follow my instructions exactly, your account will be marked as compliant. Remember, any delay or outside communication may result in immediate arrest or bank account seizure.
